ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) ventral surface with high-contrast localized white pixel clusters at the distal tips; macro-ratio estimated at 1:15 white-to-black pixel density.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-grey to black pigmentation across the majority of both lobes; high-contrast white contiguous blobs are concentrated at the lateral tips (distal margins), and discrete circular white rings are scattered across the interior dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped median notch with an approximate pixel angle of 40 degrees and a vertical depth ratio of 0.15 relative to the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes; the right lobe trailing edge displays more jagged, high-frequency peaks compared to the relatively smoother, low-frequency wave-like serrations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge trajectory sweeping upward and outward; trailing edge lobes exhibit a compound curve consisting of a convex mid-section transitioning to a concave sweep towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of high-contrast circular white pixel groups located at both distal tips; approximately 12-15 isolated circular rings (potential barnacle attachment scars) distributed across the medial and lateral lobe regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant active barnacle colonization (high-relief white clusters) on the distal lateral tips of both lobes, resulting in irregular silhouette deformation; multiple circular depigmented lesions visible across the dark integument.
other_distinctive_markers: Notable three-dimensional textural irregularity on the lateral edges where sessile organisms have created a jagged, non-linear boundary against the water background.
